testTitle: SSC Maths Chapter Wise Quiz - Free Mock Test 1
description:
SSC Maths Chapter Wise Quiz - Free Mock Test 1

This quiz is designed for SSC aspirants and covers important Maths chapters like Simplification, Percentage, Ratio and Proportion, Time and Work, Profit and Loss, Average, Simple Interest, and Compound Interest. The test follows the SSC exam pattern with 100 questions, 60 minutes, and 0.50 negative marking for each wrong answer.

questions.q_en: The price of an article is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20% on the new price. What is the net change?
questions.q_hi: किसी वस्तु की कीमत 20% बढ़ाई जाती है और फिर नई कीमत पर 20% घटाई जाती है। कुल परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Assume price = 100. After 20% increase, it becomes 120. After 20% decrease on 120, it becomes 96. Net change = 4% decrease.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 18 days and B can complete the same work in 24 days. They work together for 6 days. Then A leaves. In how many more days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 18 दिनों में और B उसी कार्य को 24 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। दोनों 6 दिन साथ काम करते हैं। फिर A छोड़ देता है। शेष कार्य को B कितने और दिनों में पूरा करेगा?
questions.explanation: Together rate = 1/18 + 1/24 = 7/72 per day. In 6 days, work done = 6 × 7/72 = 7/12. Remaining work = 5/12. B's rate = 1/24, so time needed = (5/12) ÷ (1/24) = 10 days.

questions.q_en: An article is marked 40% above its cost price and sold at a 10% discount on the marked price. What is the profit percentage?
questions.q_hi: एक वस्तु को उसके क्रय मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित किया गया और अंकित मूल्य पर 10% छूट देकर बेचा गया। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Let CP = 100. Then MP = 140. After 10% discount, SP = 126. Profit = 126 - 100 = 26%, so profit percentage is 26%.

questions.section: SSC Maths - Simple and Compound Interest
questions.q_en: Find the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on Rs. 5000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
questions.q_hi: 2 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक दर पर ₹5000 पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: For 2 years, difference between CI and SI = P × (R/100)^2 = 5000 × (10/100)^2 = 5000 × 0.01 = Rs. 50.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3:5. After 6 years, the ratio becomes 2:3. What is the present age of A?
questions.q_hi: A और B की आयु का अनुपात 3:5 है। 6 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 2:3 हो जाता है। A की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Let present ages be 3x and 5x. After 6 years: (3x + 6)/(5x + 6) = 2/3. Cross-multiplying: 9x + 18 = 10x + 12, so x = 6. Hence A's age = 3x = 18 years.

questions.q_en: The average of 8 numbers is 27. If one number 35 is removed, what is the new average of the remaining numbers?
questions.q_hi: 8 संख्याओं का औसत 27 है। यदि एक संख्या 35 हटा दी जाए, तो शेष संख्याओं का नया औसत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Total sum = 8 × 27 = 216. After removing 35, remaining sum = 181. New average = 181/7 = 25.857..., which is not in the options. So the correct exam-style answer should be 26 if rounded to the nearest whole number, but to keep strict accuracy, this question should be revised before final upload.

questions.q_en: What is the least number that must be added to 4678 to make it divisible by 9?
questions.q_hi: 4678 में न्यूनतम कितनी संख्या जोड़नी होगी ताकि वह 9 से विभाज्य हो जाए?
questions.explanation: Sum of digits = 4 + 6 + 7 + 8 = 25. Next multiple of 9 after 25 is 27. Difference = 2. So, 2 must be added.

questions.q_en: If x + 1/x = 5, then find x^2 + 1/x^2.
questions.q_hi: यदि x + 1/x = 5 है, तो x^2 + 1/x^2 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using identity: (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2. So, 25 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2. Therefore, x^2 + 1/x^2 = 23. The correct option is 2, so the answer index is 1. This question should be corrected before final upload.

questions.q_en: The perimeter of a square is 64 cm. What is its area?
questions.q_hi: एक वर्ग की परिमाप 64 सेमी है। इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of square = 4a = 64, so side a = 16 cm. Area = a² = 16² = 256 cm².
First do division and multiplication: 84 ÷ 7 = 12, 16 × 3 = 48, 18 ÷ 6 = 3. Then 12 + 48 - 3 = 57. The correct value is 57, so the options must be corrected before upload.

questions.q_en: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या में 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है और फिर 20% की कमी की जाती है। कुल परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Assume the number is 100. After 20% increase it becomes 120. After 20% decrease on 120 it becomes 96. Net change = 4% decrease.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 20 days and B can complete the same work in 30 days. In how many days will they complete the work together?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 20 दिनों में और B उसी कार्य को 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। दोनों मिलकर कार्य कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: A's rate = 1/20 per day, B's rate = 1/30 per day. Together = 1/20 + 1/30 = 5/60 = 1/12. So they finish in 12 days.

questions.q_en: The ratio of two numbers is 4:7 and their sum is 99. What is the smaller number?
questions.q_hi: दो संख्याओं का अनुपात 4:7 है और उनका योग 99 है। छोटी संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be 4x and 7x. Then 4x + 7x = 99, so 11x = 99 and x = 9. Smaller number = 4x = 36. The correct option is 2, so the answer index is 1.

questions.q_en: The radius of a circle is 7 cm. What is its circumference? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या 7 सेमी है। इसका परिमाप क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm.
First perform division and multiplication: 96 ÷ 8 = 12, 15 × 4 = 60, and 18 ÷ 3 = 6. Then 12 + 60 - 6 = 66.

questions.q_en: A number increases from 800 to 920. What is the percentage increase?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या 800 से बढ़कर 920 हो जाती है। प्रतिशत वृद्धि कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Increase = 920 - 800 = 120. Percentage increase = (120/800) × 100 = 15%.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 10 days, B in 15 days and C in 30 days. In how many days will they complete the work together?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 10 दिनों में, B 15 दिनों में और C 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। तीनों मिलकर कार्य कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: Combined rate = 1/10 + 1/15 + 1/30 = 3/30 + 2/30 + 1/30 = 6/30 = 1/5. So the work will be completed in 5 days.

questions.q_en: The average of 6 numbers is 24. If one number 30 is replaced by 42, what will be the new average?
questions.q_hi: 6 संख्याओं का औसत 24 है। यदि एक संख्या 30 के स्थान पर 42 रख दी जाए, तो नया औसत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Original sum = 6 × 24 = 144. Replacing 30 with 42 increases the sum by 12, so new sum = 156. New average = 156/6 = 26.

questions.q_en: An article is purchased for Rs. 1000 and marked 25% above the cost price. If it is sold after giving a 5% discount on the marked price, what is the profit percentage?
questions.q_hi: एक वस्तु ₹1000 में खरीदी गई और उसे क्रय मूल्य से 25% अधिक अंकित किया गया। यदि अंकित मूल्य पर 5% छूट देकर बेचा जाए, तो लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: CP = 1000. MP = 1250. After 5% discount, SP = 1250 × 0.95 = 1187.5. Profit = 1187.5 - 1000 = 187.5, so profit percentage = 18.75%.

questions.q_en: What is the least number that must be added to 5347 to make it divisible by 8?
questions.q_hi: 5347 में न्यूनतम कितनी संख्या जोड़नी होगी ताकि वह 8 से विभाज्य हो जाए?
questions.explanation: For divisibility by 8, the last three digits are enough. 347 ÷ 8 gives remainder 3, so 5 must be added to make it divisible by 8.

questions.q_en: If x - 1/x = 3, then find x^2 + 1/x^2.
questions.q_hi: यदि x - 1/x = 3 है, तो x^2 + 1/x^2 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using the identity (x - 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 - 2. So, 9 = x^2 + 1/x^2 - 2, which gives x^2 + 1/x^2 = 11.

questions.section: SSC Maths - Simple Interest and Compound Interest
questions.q_en: Find the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on Rs. 4000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
questions.q_hi: 2 वर्षों के लिए 5% वार्षिक दर पर ₹4000 पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = P × (R/100)^2. So, 4000 × (5/100)^2 = 4000 × 0.0025 = Rs. 10.

questions.q_en: A 40-litre mixture of milk and water is in the ratio 3:1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 3:2?
questions.q_hi: 40 लीटर के दूध और पानी के मिश्रण में अनुपात 3:1 है। अनुपात 3:2 करने के लिए कितने लीटर पानी मिलाना होगा?
questions.explanation: Milk = 3/4 of 40 = 30 litres and water = 10 litres. For ratio 3:2, if milk is 30 then water should be 20. So, 10 litres of water must be added.

questions.q_en: The perimeter of a rectangle is 54 cm and its length is 15 cm. What is its area?
questions.q_hi: एक आयत का परिमाप 54 सेमी है और उसकी लंबाई 15 सेमी है। इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b) = 54, so l + b = 27. Given l = 15, breadth = 12. Area = 15 × 12 = 180 cm².

questions.q_en: If x + 1/x = 4, then find x^3 + 1/x^3.
questions.q_hi: यदि x + 1/x = 4 है, तो x^3 + 1/x^3 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.q_en: A is 25% more efficient than B. Together they complete a work in 12 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
questions.q_hi: A, B से 25% अधिक कुशल है। दोनों मिलकर एक कार्य 12 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं। B अकेले वह कार्य कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?
questions.explanation: Let B's efficiency be b. Then A's efficiency = 1.25b. Together, 2.25b = 1/12 work per day. So b = 1/(12×2.25) = 1/27. Hence, B alone takes 27 days.

questions.q_en: A 30-litre mixture of milk and water is in the ratio 7:3. How much water must be added to make the ratio 7:5?
questions.q_hi: 30 लीटर के दूध और पानी के मिश्रण में अनुपात 7:3 है। अनुपात 7:5 करने के लिए कितने लीटर पानी मिलाना होगा?
questions.explanation: Milk = 7/10 of 30 = 21 litres and water = 9 litres. For ratio 7:5, if milk remains 21, water should be 15. So, 6 litres of water must be added.

questions.q_en: A number is increased by 20%, then increased by 25%, and finally decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या में 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है, फिर 25% की वृद्धि की जाती है, और अंत में 20% की कमी की जाती है। कुल परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Take the number as 100. After 20% increase it becomes 120. After 25% increase it becomes 150. After 20% decrease it becomes 120. Net change = 20% increase.

questions.q_en: The side of a square is 14 cm. A circle is inscribed in the square. What is the area of the circle? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक वर्ग की भुजा 14 सेमी है। उसमें एक वृत्त अंतःस्थित है। वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: In an inscribed circle, the diameter equals the side of the square. So diameter = 14 cm and radius = 7 cm. Area = πr² = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².

questions.q_en: If x + 1/x = 6, then find x^2 + 1/x^2.
questions.q_hi: यदि x + 1/x = 6 है, तो x^2 + 1/x^2 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using the identity (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2, we get 36 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2. Hence, x^2 + 1/x^2 = 34.

questions.q_en: A is 40% more efficient than B. Together they complete a work in 20 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
questions.q_hi: A, B से 40% अधिक कुशल है। दोनों मिलकर एक कार्य 20 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं। B अकेले वह कार्य कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?
questions.explanation: Let B's efficiency be b. Then A's efficiency = 1.4b. Together, 2.4b = 1/20 work per day. So b = 1/48. Therefore, B alone completes the work in 48 days.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 5:7. After 6 years, the ratio becomes 3:4. What is the present age of B?
questions.q_hi: A और B की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 5:7 है। 6 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 3:4 हो जाता है। B की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Let the present ages be 5x and 7x. Then (5x + 6)/(7x + 6) = 3/4. Cross-multiplying gives 20x + 24 = 21x + 18, so x = 6. Hence B's age = 7x = 42 years.

questions.q_en: An article is purchased for Rs. 2500 and marked 60% above the cost price. If it is sold after giving a 20% discount on the marked price, what is the profit percentage?
questions.q_hi: एक वस्तु ₹2500 में खरीदी गई और उसे क्रय मूल्य से 60% अधिक अंकित किया गया। यदि अंकित मूल्य पर 20% छूट देकर बेचा जाए, तो लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?

questions.q_en: A square has side 14 cm. A circle is circumscribed about the square. What is the area of the circle? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक वर्ग की भुजा 14 सेमी है। उस वर्ग के चारों ओर एक वृत्त बनाया गया है। वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: For a circumscribed circle, the diameter equals the diagonal of the square. Diagonal = 14√2, so radius = 7√2. Area = πr² = 22/7 × 98 = 308 cm².

questions.q_en: A number leaves remainders 5 and 7 when divided by 7 and 9 respectively. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 63?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या को 7 से भाग देने पर शेष 5 और 9 से भाग देने पर शेष 7 आता है। उसी संख्या को 63 से भाग देने पर शेष क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: We need a number x such that x ≡ 5 (mod 7) and x ≡ 7 (mod 9). Checking multiples of 7-remainder 5 gives 5, 12, 19, 26, 33, 40, 47, 54, 61. Among these, 61 leaves remainder 7 when divided by 9. So the remainder modulo 63 is 61.

questions.section: SSC Maths - Time, Speed and Distance
questions.q_en: A train 450 m long passes a platform in 18 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.q_hi: एक 450 मीटर लंबी ट्रेन एक प्लेटफॉर्म को 18 सेकंड में पार करती है। ट्रेन की गति km/h में कितनी है?
questions.explanation: When a train passes a platform, distance covered = train length + platform length. But since only the train length is given, this question should be read as the train covering 450 m in 18 seconds. Speed = 450/18 = 25 m/s = 90 km/h. The logic is correct only if the full 450 m is the total distance covered.

questions.q_en: A invests Rs. 18,000 for 8 months, B invests Rs. 15,000 for 12 months, and C invests Rs. 12,000 for 15 months. What is the ratio of their shares in the profit?
questions.q_hi: A ₹18,000 को 8 महीने के लिए, B ₹15,000 को 12 महीने के लिए, और C ₹12,000 को 15 महीने के लिए निवेश करता है। लाभ में उनके हिस्सों का अनुपात क्या होगा?

questions.q_en: Evaluate: √72 + √18 - √8
The average of 12 numbers is 45. If one number 36 is replaced by 60, what is the new average?
questions.q_hi: 12 संख्याओं का औसत 45 है। यदि एक संख्या 36 के स्थान पर 60 रख दी जाए, तो नया औसत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Original sum = 12 × 45 = 540. Replacing 36 by 60 increases the sum by 24. New sum = 564. New average = 564/12 = 47.

questions.q_en: Two dice are thrown together. What is the probability of getting at least one 6?
questions.q_hi: दो पासे एक साथ फेंके जाते हैं। कम से कम एक 6 आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.explanation: Probability of no 6 on a die = 5/6. For two dice, probability of no 6 on both = (5/6)² = 25/36. Therefore, probability of at least one 6 = 1 - 25/36 = 11/36.

questions.q_en: If x + y = 12 and xy = 35, find x² + y².
questions.q_hi: यदि x + y = 12 और xy = 35 है, तो x² + y² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using the identity x² + y² = (x + y)² - 2xy, we get 144 - 70 = 74.

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 15 hours, pipe B fills it in 20 hours, and a drain empties it in 30 hours. If all are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.q_hi: पाइप A एक टंकी को 15 घंटे में भरता है, पाइप B 20 घंटे में भरता है, और एक नाली उसे 30 घंटे में खाली करती है। यदि तीनों एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो टंकी कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/15 + 1/20 - 1/30 = 4/60 + 3/60 - 2/60 = 5/60 = 1/12. So the tank will be filled in 12 hours.

questions.q_en: The diagonal of a rectangle is 25 cm and its breadth is 7 cm. What is its area?
questions.q_hi: एक आयत का विकर्ण 25 सेमी है और उसकी चौड़ाई 7 सेमी है। इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras, length² = diagonal² - breadth² = 25² - 7² = 625 - 49 = 576. So length = 24 cm. Area = 24 × 7 = 168 cm².

questions.q_en: Find the sum of the first 10 terms of an AP whose first term is 50 and common difference is -3.
questions.q_hi: उस AP के पहले 10 पदों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका पहला पद 50 है और सामान्य अंतर -3 है।

questions.explanation: First do division and multiplication: 144 ÷ 12 = 12, 18 × 5 = 90, and 36 ÷ 6 = 6. Then 12 + 90 - 6 = 96.

questions.q_en: A number is increased by 30%, then decreased by 10%, and then increased by 20%. What is the net percentage change?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या में 30% की वृद्धि की जाती है, फिर 10% की कमी की जाती है, और फिर 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है। कुल प्रतिशत परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Take the number as 100. After 30% increase it becomes 130. After 10% decrease it becomes 117. After 20% increase it becomes 140.4. So the net change is 40.4% increase.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 20 days and B can complete the same work in 30 days. A works alone for 5 days and then B joins. In how many total days will the work be completed?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 20 दिनों में और B उसी कार्य को 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। A 5 दिन अकेले काम करता है और फिर B जुड़ जाता है। कार्य कुल कितने दिनों में पूरा होगा?
questions.explanation: A's 5-day work = 5/20 = 1/4. Remaining work = 3/4. Together, A and B's rate = 1/20 + 1/30 = 1/12 per day. Time for remaining work = (3/4) ÷ (1/12) = 9 days. Total time = 5 + 9 = 14 days.

questions.q_en: An article is purchased for Rs. 2000 and marked 50% above the cost price. It is sold after two successive discounts of 10% and 5% on the marked price. What is the profit percentage?
questions.q_hi: एक वस्तु ₹2000 में खरीदी गई और उसे क्रय मूल्य से 50% अधिक अंकित किया गया। इसे अंकित मूल्य पर 10% और फिर 5% की दो क्रमिक छूटों के बाद बेचा जाता है। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: CP = 2000. MP = 2000 × 1.5 = 3000. After 10% discount, price = 2700. After another 5% discount, SP = 2700 × 0.95 = 2565. Profit = 2565 - 2000 = 565. Profit percentage = (565/2000) × 100 = 28.25%.

questions.q_en: A rhombus has diagonals 24 cm and 10 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.q_hi: एक समचतुर्भुज के विकर्ण 24 सेमी और 10 सेमी हैं। इसका परिमाप क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: In a rhombus, diagonals bisect each other at right angles. Half-diagonals are 12 and 5. Side = √(12² + 5²) = √169 = 13 cm. Perimeter = 4 × 13 = 52 cm.

questions.q_en: What is the least positive number that leaves remainders 1, 2, and 3 when divided by 3, 4, and 5 respectively?
questions.q_hi: सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 3, 4 और 5 से भाग देने पर क्रमशः 1, 2 और 3 शेष देती है?
questions.explanation: Checking the numbers that satisfy all three congruences, 58 gives remainder 1 when divided by 3, remainder 2 when divided by 4, and remainder 3 when divided by 5. So the least such number is 58.

questions.q_en: If x + y = 10 and xy = 21, find x^3 + y^3.
questions.q_hi: यदि x + y = 10 और xy = 21 है, तो x^3 + y^3 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.q_en: A invests Rs. 24,000 for 8 months, B invests Rs. 18,000 for 10 months, and C invests Rs. 30,000 for 6 months. What is the ratio of their shares in the profit?
questions.q_hi: A ₹24,000 को 8 महीने के लिए, B ₹18,000 को 10 महीने के लिए, और C ₹30,000 को 6 महीने के लिए निवेश करता है। लाभ में उनके हिस्सों का अनुपात क्या होगा?

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 8 hours, pipe B fills it in 12 hours, and a drain empties it in 24 hours. If all are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.q_hi: पाइप A एक टंकी को 8 घंटे में भरता है, पाइप B 12 घंटे में भरता है, और एक नाली उसे 24 घंटे में खाली करती है। यदि तीनों एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो टंकी कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/8 + 1/12 - 1/24 = 3/24 + 2/24 - 1/24 = 4/24 = 1/6. So the tank will be filled in 6 hours.

questions.q_en: The average of 15 numbers is 28. If the average of the first 8 numbers is 26 and the average of the last 6 numbers is 30, what is the 9th number?
questions.q_hi: 15 संख्याओं का औसत 28 है। यदि पहली 8 संख्याओं का औसत 26 है और अंतिम 6 संख्याओं का औसत 30 है, तो 9वीं संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total sum of 15 numbers = 15 × 28 = 420. Sum of first 8 numbers = 8 × 26 = 208. Sum of last 6 numbers = 6 × 30 = 180. The 9th number = 420 - 208 - 180 = 32.

questions.section: SSC Maths - Time, Speed and Distance
questions.q_en: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 10 seconds. Another train 100 m long is moving in the opposite direction at 54 km/h. If the two trains cross each other in 10 seconds, what is the speed of the first train?
questions.q_hi: 150 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन एक खंभे को 10 सेकंड में पार करती है। 100 मीटर लंबी दूसरी ट्रेन 54 km/h की गति से विपरीत दिशा में चल रही है। यदि दोनों ट्रेनें 10 सेकंड में एक-दूसरे को पार करती हैं, तो पहली ट्रेन की गति क्या होगी?
questions.explanation: When two trains cross each other, relative speed = total length / time = (150 + 100) / 10 = 25 m/s = 90 km/h. The second train's speed is 54 km/h. Therefore, the first train's speed = 90 - 54 = 36 km/h.

questions.q_en: Two cards are drawn at random from a standard deck of 52 cards without replacement. What is the probability that at least one card is a king?
questions.q_hi: 52 पत्तों की मानक गड्डी से बिना replacement के दो पत्ते यादृच्छिक रूप से निकाले जाते हैं। कम से कम एक पत्ता king होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.explanation: Probability of no king in two draws = (48/52) × (47/51) = 188/221. Therefore, probability of at least one king = 1 - 188/221 = 33/221.

questions.q_en: Find the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years.
questions.q_hi: 2 वर्षों के लिए 15% वार्षिक दर पर ₹8000 पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.q_en: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of an AP whose first term is 7 and common difference is 3.
questions.q_hi: उस AP के पहले 20 पदों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका पहला पद 7 है और सामान्य अंतर 3 है।

questions.q_en: A container has milk and water in the ratio 5:2. If the total mixture is 21 litres, how much water must be added to make the ratio 5:3?
questions.q_hi: एक बर्तन में दूध और पानी का अनुपात 5:2 है। यदि मिश्रण की कुल मात्रा 21 लीटर है, तो अनुपात 5:3 करने के लिए कितने लीटर पानी मिलाना होगा?
questions.explanation: Milk = 5/7 of 21 = 15 litres and water = 6 litres. For the ratio 5:3, when milk stays 15 litres, water should be 9 litres. So 3 litres of water must be added.
First do division and multiplication: 225 ÷ 15 = 15, 14 × 6 = 84, and 48 ÷ 8 × 5 = 30. Then 15 + 84 - 30 = 69.

questions.q_en: A number is increased by 40%, then decreased by 30%, and then increased by 10%. What is the net percentage change?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या में 40% की वृद्धि की जाती है, फिर 30% की कमी की जाती है, और फिर 10% की वृद्धि की जाती है। कुल प्रतिशत परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Take the number as 100. After 40% increase it becomes 140. After 30% decrease it becomes 98. After 10% increase it becomes 107.8. So the net change is 7.8% increase.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 24 days and B can complete the same work in 36 days. A works alone for 4 days and then B joins. In how many total days will the work be completed?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 24 दिनों में और B उसी कार्य को 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। A 4 दिन अकेले काम करता है और फिर B जुड़ जाता है। कार्य कुल कितने दिनों में पूरा होगा?
questions.explanation: A's 4-day work = 4/24 = 1/6. Remaining work = 5/6. Together, A and B's rate = 1/24 + 1/36 = 5/72 per day. Time for remaining work = (5/6) ÷ (5/72) = 12 days. Total time = 4 + 12 = 16 days.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 4:7. After 6 years, the ratio becomes 5:8. What is the present age of A?
questions.q_hi: A और B की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 4:7 है। 6 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 5:8 हो जाता है। A की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Let the present ages be 4x and 7x. Then (4x + 6)/(7x + 6) = 5/8. Cross-multiplying gives 32x + 48 = 35x + 30, so 18 = 3x and x = 6. Hence A's age = 4x = 24 years.

questions.q_en: The circumference of a circle is 88 cm. What is its area? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक वृत्त की परिधि 88 सेमी है। इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2πr = 88. So r = 88 × 7 / 44 = 14 cm. Area = πr² = 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 616 cm².

questions.q_en: What is the least positive number that leaves remainders 5, 7, and 8 when divided by 6, 8, and 9 respectively?
questions.q_hi: सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 6, 8 और 9 से भाग देने पर क्रमशः 5, 7 और 8 शेष देती है?
questions.explanation: The required number is 1 less than a multiple of 6, 8, and 9. LCM of 6, 8, and 9 is 72. Therefore, the least such number is 72 - 1 = 71.

questions.q_en: If x - y = 3 and xy = 10, find x² + y².
questions.q_hi: यदि x - y = 3 और xy = 10 है, तो x² + y² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using the identity (x - y)² = x² + y² - 2xy, we get 9 = x² + y² - 20. Hence, x² + y² = 29.

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 10 hours, pipe B fills it in 15 hours, and a drain empties it in 30 hours. If all are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.q_hi: पाइप A एक टंकी को 10 घंटे में भरता है, पाइप B 15 घंटे में भरता है, और एक नाली उसे 30 घंटे में खाली करती है। यदि तीनों एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो टंकी कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/10 + 1/15 - 1/30 = 3/30 + 2/30 - 1/30 = 4/30 = 2/15 tank per hour. So the tank will be filled in 15/2 = 7.5 hours.

questions.q_en: Two cards are drawn at random from a standard deck of 52 cards without replacement. What is the probability that both cards are red?
questions.q_hi: 52 पत्तों की मानक गड्डी से बिना replacement के दो पत्ते यादृच्छिक रूप से निकाले जाते हैं। दोनों पत्तों के लाल होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.explanation: There are 26 red cards out of 52. Probability of first red = 26/52 and second red = 25/51. So, probability = (26/52) × (25/51) = 25/102.

questions.q_en: Find the sum of the first 15 terms of an AP whose first term is 12 and common difference is 4.
questions.q_hi: उस AP के पहले 15 पदों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका पहला पद 12 है और सामान्य अंतर 4 है।

questions.q_en: A cylindrical vessel has radius 7 cm and height 20 cm. What is its volume? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक बेलनाकार बर्तन की त्रिज्या 7 सेमी और ऊँचाई 20 सेमी है। इसका आयतन क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Volume of cylinder = πr²h = 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 20 = 22 × 7 × 20 = 3080 cm³.

questions.q_en: A invests Rs. 18,000 for 12 months, B invests Rs. 24,000 for 9 months, and C invests Rs. 15,000 for 18 months. What is the ratio of their shares in the profit?
questions.q_hi: A ₹18,000 को 12 महीने के लिए, B ₹24,000 को 9 महीने के लिए, और C ₹15,000 को 18 महीने के लिए निवेश करता है। लाभ में उनके हिस्सों का अनुपात क्या होगा?

questions.section: SSC Maths - Time, Speed and Distance
questions.q_en: A train 180 m long passes a pole in 9 seconds. How long will it take to cross a platform 270 m long?
questions.q_hi: 180 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन एक खंभे को 9 सेकंड में पार करती है। 270 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफॉर्म को पार करने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.explanation: Speed of the train = 180/9 = 20 m/s. To cross the platform, distance = 180 + 270 = 450 m. Time = 450/20 = 22.5 seconds.

questions.q_en: A right triangle has hypotenuse 25 cm and one leg 7 cm. What is its area?
questions.q_hi: एक समकोण त्रिभुज का कर्ण 25 सेमी और एक भुजा 7 सेमी है। इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?

questions.explanation: First perform division and multiplication: 256 ÷ 16 = 16, 27 × 4 = 108, and 64 ÷ 8 = 8. Then 16 + 108 - 8 = 116.

questions.q_en: A number is increased by 50%, then decreased by 20%, and then increased by 10%. What is the net percentage change?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या में 50% की वृद्धि की जाती है, फिर 20% की कमी की जाती है, और फिर 10% की वृद्धि की जाती है। कुल प्रतिशत परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Take the number as 100. After 50% increase it becomes 150. After 20% decrease it becomes 120. After 10% increase it becomes 132. So the net change is 32% increase.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 30 days and B can complete the same work in 40 days. A works alone for 8 days and then B joins. In how many total days will the work be completed?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 30 दिनों में और B उसी कार्य को 40 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। A 8 दिन अकेले काम करता है और फिर B जुड़ जाता है। कार्य कुल कितने दिनों में पूरा होगा?
questions.explanation: A's 8-day work = 8/30 = 4/15. Remaining work = 11/15. Together, A and B's rate = 1/30 + 1/40 = 7/120 per day. Time for remaining work = (11/15) ÷ (7/120) = 88/7 = 12 4/7 days.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 5:8. After 9 years, the ratio becomes 2:3. What is the present age of A?
questions.q_hi: A और B की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 5:8 है। 9 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 2:3 हो जाता है। A की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Let the present ages be 5x and 8x. Then (5x + 9)/(8x + 9) = 2/3. Cross-multiplying gives 15x + 27 = 16x + 18, so x = 9. Hence A's age = 5x = 45 years.

questions.q_en: The radius of a sphere is 7 cm. What is its volume? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: एक गोले की त्रिज्या 7 सेमी है। उसका आयतन क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × r³ = 4/3 × 22/7 × 7 × 7 × 7 = 4/3 × 22 × 49 = 4312/3 = 1437.33... So the options should be corrected before upload.

questions.q_en: What is the least positive number that leaves remainders 2, 3, and 4 when divided by 3, 4, and 5 respectively?
questions.q_hi: सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 3, 4 और 5 से भाग देने पर क्रमशः 2, 3 और 4 शेष देती है?
questions.explanation: The required number is 1 less than a multiple of 3, 4, and 5. LCM of 3, 4, and 5 is 60. Therefore, the least such number is 60 - 1 = 59.

questions.q_en: If x + y = 14 and xy = 40, find x² + y².
questions.q_hi: यदि x + y = 14 और xy = 40 है, तो x² + y² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using the identity x² + y² = (x + y)² - 2xy, we get 14² - 2×40 = 196 - 80 = 116.

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 12 hours, pipe B fills it in 18 hours, and a drain empties it in 36 hours. If all are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.q_hi: पाइप A एक टंकी को 12 घंटे में भरता है, पाइप B 18 घंटे में भरता है, और एक नाली उसे 36 घंटे में खाली करती है। यदि तीनों एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो टंकी कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/12 + 1/18 - 1/36 = 3/36 + 2/36 - 1/36 = 4/36 = 1/9. So the tank will be filled in 9 hours.

questions.q_en: A coin is tossed 3 times. What is the probability of getting exactly two heads?
questions.q_hi: एक सिक्का 3 बार उछाला जाता है। ठीक दो हेड आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total outcomes when a coin is tossed 3 times = 2³ = 8. Exactly two heads can occur in 3 ways. So the probability = 3/8.

questions.q_en: Find the sum of the first 12 terms of an AP whose first term is 9 and common difference is 5.
questions.q_hi: उस AP के पहले 12 पदों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका पहला पद 9 है और सामान्य अंतर 5 है।

questions.q_en: A invests Rs. 20,000 for 10 months, B invests Rs. 15,000 for 12 months, and C invests Rs. 30,000 for 5 months. What is the ratio of their shares in the profit?
questions.q_hi: A ₹20,000 को 10 महीने के लिए, B ₹15,000 को 12 महीने के लिए, और C ₹30,000 को 5 महीने के लिए निवेश करता है। लाभ में उनके हिस्सों का अनुपात क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Profit share is proportional to capital × time. A = 20000 × 10 = 200000, B = 15000 × 12 = 180000, C = 30000 × 5 = 150000. Ratio = 20:18:15.

questions.section: SSC Maths - Time, Speed and Distance
questions.q_en: A train 240 m long passes a pole in 12 seconds. How long will it take to cross a platform 160 m long?
questions.q_hi: 240 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन एक खंभे को 12 सेकंड में पार करती है। 160 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफॉर्म को पार करने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.explanation: Speed of the train = 240/12 = 20 m/s. To cross the platform, distance = 240 + 160 = 400 m. Time = 400/20 = 20 seconds.

questions.q_en: A rectangle has diagonal 26 cm and breadth 10 cm. What is its area?
questions.q_hi: एक आयत का विकर्ण 26 सेमी और चौड़ाई 10 सेमी है। इसका क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras, length² = diagonal² - breadth² = 26² - 10² = 676 - 100 = 576. So length = 24 cm. Area = 24 × 10 = 240 cm².

questions.q_en: A container has milk and water in the ratio 4:3. If the total mixture is 35 litres, how much water must be added to make the ratio 4:5?
questions.q_hi: एक बर्तन में दूध और पानी का अनुपात 4:3 है। यदि मिश्रण की कुल मात्रा 35 लीटर है, तो अनुपात 4:5 करने के लिए कितने लीटर पानी मिलाना होगा?
questions.explanation: Milk = 4/7 of 35 = 20 litres and water = 15 litres. For the ratio 4:5, when milk remains 20 litres, water should be 25 litres. So 10 litres of water must be added.

questions.q_en: A number is increased by 25%, then decreased by 20%, and then increased by 10%. What is the net percentage change?
questions.q_hi: एक संख्या में 25% की वृद्धि की जाती है, फिर 20% की कमी की जाती है, और फिर 10% की वृद्धि की जाती है। कुल प्रतिशत परिवर्तन क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Take the number as 100. After 25% increase it becomes 125. After 20% decrease it becomes 100. After 10% increase it becomes 110. So the net change is 10% increase.

questions.q_en: A can complete a work in 18 days, B in 24 days and C in 36 days. A works alone for 3 days and then B and C join. In how many total days will the work be completed?
questions.q_hi: A किसी कार्य को 18 दिनों में, B 24 दिनों में और C 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। A 3 दिन अकेले काम करता है और फिर B तथा C जुड़ जाते हैं। कार्य कुल कितने दिनों में पूरा होगा?
questions.explanation: A's 3-day work = 3/18 = 1/6. Remaining work = 5/6. Combined rate of B and C = 1/24 + 1/36 = 5/72 per day. Time for remaining work = (5/6) ÷ (5/72) = 12 days. Total time = 3 + 12 = 15 days.

questions.q_en: The ratio of the present ages of A and B is 3:4. After 5 years, the ratio becomes 4:5. What is the present age of A?
questions.q_hi: A और B की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 3:4 है। 5 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 4:5 हो जाता है। A की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Let the present ages be 3x and 4x. Then (3x + 5)/(4x + 5) = 4/5. Cross-multiplying gives 15x + 25 = 16x + 20, so x = 5. Hence A's age = 3x = 15 years.

questions.q_en: What is the area of a circle whose radius is 21 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.q_hi: 21 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल क्या होगा? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Area of circle = πr² = 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 22 × 63 = 1386 cm².

questions.q_en: What is the least positive number that leaves remainders 1, 2, and 3 when divided by 2, 3, and 4 respectively?
questions.q_hi: सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 2, 3 और 4 से भाग देने पर क्रमशः 1, 2 और 3 शेष देती है?
questions.explanation: Check the numbers satisfying all three conditions. 11 leaves remainder 1 when divided by 2, remainder 2 when divided by 3, and remainder 3 when divided by 4. So the least such number is 11.

questions.q_en: If x + 1/x = 7, then find x² + 1/x².
questions.q_hi: यदि x + 1/x = 7 है, तो x² + 1/x² का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using the identity (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2, we get 49 = x² + 1/x² + 2. Hence, x² + 1/x² = 47.

questions.q_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 14 hours, pipe B fills it in 21 hours, and a drain empties it in 42 hours. If all are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.q_hi: पाइप A एक टंकी को 14 घंटे में भरता है, पाइप B 21 घंटे में भरता है, और एक नाली उसे 42 घंटे में खाली करती है। यदि तीनों एक साथ खोल दिए जाएँ, तो टंकी कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/14 + 1/21 - 1/42 = 3/42 + 2/42 - 1/42 = 4/42 = 2/21 tank per hour. Therefore, the tank will be filled in 21/2 = 10.5 hours.

questions.q_en: Two dice are thrown together. What is the probability of getting a sum of 9?
questions.q_hi: दो पासे एक साथ फेंके जाते हैं। योग 9 आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.explanation: The favorable outcomes for sum 9 are (3,6), (4,5), (5,4), and (6,3), i.e. 4 outcomes. Total outcomes = 36. So the probability = 4/36 = 1/9.

questions.q_en: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of an AP whose first term is 15 and common difference is 2.
questions.q_hi: उस AP के पहले 20 पदों का योग ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका पहला पद 15 है और सामान्य अंतर 2 है।
